newsitem.title: UK: N.Ireland security post hit by rocket.
newsitem.headline: N.Ireland security post hit by rocket.

text.p: A security post beside Northern Ireland's High Court in Belfast was hit by a rocket on Monday, Britain's Press Association news agency said.
It said there were no immediate reports of injuries. But the BBC said one person had been injured in the blast and that a vehicle was on fire.
"We do believe it was an attack on a security post," a police spokesman said.

The attack followed the discovery on New Year's Eve of a huge Irish Republican Army bomb at Belfast Castle which was defused by police. British army experts on Sunday made safe a smaller bomb found near a village on the border with the Irish Republic.
The IRA, fighting to end British rule of Northern Ireland, ended a 17-month ceasefire in February last year.
